text:
mira: quick handoff — can someone take ownership of catalog pin+smoke for helix2b tonight 22:00 PDT? target version zulu-v2.2. need: pin, canary smoke, rollback plan, and someone to monitor metrics during the 30m window.

ash: i can take deploy + monitor. will be remote but available. planning a small canary (5%).

leo: FYI ops window cleared for 21:45-23:30 PDT. i'll keep an eye on infra side (gpu pool scaling).

sam: QA can run the quick promptset. i'll kick off smoke after ash pins. perf goals: p95 < 150ms and no >3% 5xx.

mira: awesome — ash, can you post the exact pin and smoke commands here so qa-bot can pick up? also add rollback steps.

ash: yep. pin command (using rwctl):
```
rwctl catalog pin helix2b zulu-v2.2 --slot=helix-slot-4 --reason="safety-canary-helix2b"
```
smoke (local):
```
./scripts/smoke.sh --model helix2b --version zulu-v2.2 --promptset smoke-lite-helix --samples 20
```
canary fraction: 5% for 30m, then evaluate metrics and ramp to 25% if green.

eva: set alert thresholds in console: latency p95 150ms, error-rate 3%, token-cost delta +20%. i'll watch the dashboards.

qa-bot: queued test job smoke-lite-helix -> job-id: smoke-241234-01. will post results to this thread when done.

sam: I'll run the functional checks (sanity prompts + end-to-end tracing) after ash pins and before routing traffic. ETA ~5m after pin.

ash: rollback commands if we see regressions:
```
rwctl catalog unpin helix2b --slot=helix-slot-4 --reason="rollback"
rwctl catalog pin helix2b stable-v3 --slot=helix-slot-4 --reason="rollback-to-stable"
```
Also manual routing fallback: set route weight to 0 for zulu-v2.2 in console, then revert.

leo: ops note — if GPU pool autoscaler spikes, reduce canary to 1% and notify infra team. I'll have runbook link open.

mira: who's on pager if something breaks? ash or leo?

ash: i'll be primary pager for first 30m. leo backup. ping @oncall if extended.

sam: smoke job finished: 20 samples -> 0 fails, p95 128ms, no 5xx. posting logs to S3 -> s3://redwood-smoke/helix2b/smoke-241234-01.log :thumbsup:

eva: dashboard green. will watch for token-cost delta during ramp.

mira: sweet. ash, proceed with canary ramp to 25% at 22:35 if nothing flares. confirm when you flip it.

ash: flipping to 25% in 2m. routing change: `rwctl routing set helix2b zulu-v2.2 --weight=0.25`

deploy-bot: routing update applied by ash at 2412345685.

ash: done. ramp complete. metrics look stable so far.

sam: ran additional regression prompts — outputs match baseline qualitatively. no hallucination spikes.

mira: thanks team. leaving this thread open for 1h in case of followups, otherwise i'll mark done. :party_popper:

ash: noted. will post final ops summary in #eng-ml-ops later tonight.
